title: Cheese Grater with Garlic Crusher- Box Grater Vegetable Shredder with 3 Stainless Steel Blades - Graters for Kitchen- Cheese Graters with Handle - Garlic Mincer Tool and Vegetable Peeler
description:
About this item
Hand Grater with Bonus Garlic Press Includes 3 different grating surfaces, removable non-slip base, 2 different measurement units, a thick and comfortable handle, and vegetable peeler. In addition, this versatile kitchen gadget comes with a garlic mincer that can be used as a herb grinder, garlic peeler and garlic chopper. It will streamline your cooking by multitasking as a ginger grater, carrot shredder, parmesan cheese grater and much more.
Cheese Grater With Storage Container And Measurements. The smart base of this potato grater saves you time and space by storing your freshly grated food, while the clear sides provide two units of measurement: cups and milliliters. There's no messy kitchen, no need for extra utensils to grate into or measuring devices. The non-slip base and thick handle provide grip and comfort.
Effortless Blade Switching. This kitchen grater offers 3 different grating surfaces: coarse, medium, and fine. Switching between surfaces is zero-hassle, with no need for multiple different graters. The compact design fits conveniently into drawers and saves you kitchen space.
Multifunctional Y-Peeler Included. It features sharp peeler and julienne blades and potato eye and apple spot removers on the sides. The handle is large, comfortable, and sturdy. So for anything that your versatile handheld cheese grater cannot do in the kitchen, the peeler and garlic chopper can fill in.
Easy To Clean. The grating surfaces and base are removable for easy cleaning and are top-rack dishwasher safe. We've also included a cleaning brush for the finer surfaces and dried and sticky bits that are difficult to clean. This small cheese grater is convenient all-around!
